# Every county of the Empire of Britannia.
eir_brit_100_trigger = {
	any_sub_realm_county = {
		count >= 93
		empire = title:e_britannia
	}
}

# An Irish emperor.
eir_irish_emperor_trigger = {
	culture = culture:irish
	highest_held_title_tier >= tier_empire
}

# A ruler whose culture took the Forest Warriors tradition.
eir_forest_culture_trigger = {
	culture ?= { has_cultural_parameter = eir_forest_warriors }
}
